caveats: Profiles not captured because the system is in accessibility mode 'increased-contrast' and these claim another: apple-macos-26.5-1x-light-standard, apple-macos-26.5-1x-dark-standard, apple-macos-26.5-1x-light-reduced-transparency, apple-macos-26.5-2x-light-standard, apple-macos-26.5-2x-dark-standard. macOS exposes reduce-transparency and increase-contrast as read-only environment values, so each such profile needs its own run with the corresponding System Settings toggle on (Accessibility > Display).

Captured with reduce-transparency also on. That is not contamination: macOS couples the toggles (Increase Contrast force-enables Reduce Transparency, and the transparency checkbox cannot be uncleared while contrast is on — user-verified 2026-08-29), so this is the only reachable increased-contrast state and the one a real user sees.
